notes: Special-election overperformance is descriptive, not a random sample or causal estimate.
The demographic model uses ecological district-level relationships and must not be interpreted as individual voter behavior.

All 435 shapes use the Census Bureau's official 120th-Congress geography. In the ten redrawn states, 2020–2024 ACS block-group and tract estimates are assigned by representative point and reaggregated to the new districts.
The 2022 House comparison is shown only where district lines are comparable and both major parties received at least 90% of parsed candidate votes.
